title: ProductRecommendationInput (V2)
description: Phase 5 V2 input contract for product-recommendation (legacy skill dir: recommendation). Closes the Phase-0 P1 break: `candidate_solutions` had NO producer in V1. In V2 the SolutionPlan is the canonical source of candidate solutions, so candidate_solutions is FORBIDDEN as an input and derived at the adapter boundary by scripts/solution_to_candidates.py.

not.description: P1 guard: V2 input must NOT carry candidate_solutions. It is derived from solution_plan.

solution_plan.description: Canonical SolutionPlan (envelope or raw payload). THE canonical source of candidate solutions.

knowledge_evidence.description: Canonical KnowledgeEvidence, obtained via the shared Evidence Provider (Phase 4).

product_candidates.description: Step 2: output of product-candidate-provider (envelope, bare payload, or plain candidate list). When supplied, recommendation consumes REAL catalog products instead of strategy-level placeholders. When absent, the engine falls back to deriving candidates from solution_plan (unchanged legacy behaviour).

constraints.description: Hard/soft constraints resolved by the orchestrator. If supplied and a candidate lacks product-level data (premium/term/liquidity), the constraint is reported as UNVERIFIABLE, never as a pass.
